x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, issue #1419 (voting-ranked-preference-ballot, REQ-PRF-001 to REQ-PRF-005). ranked-choice was a votingMethod enum value nothing read. A ranked round now carries its options, a ranked vote carries the member's full ordering in its own field, and closing the round stores the Borda count. Vote.value gains `ranked` (fragments union enum lists), so the required field stays valid on a ranked ballot without pretending to be for or against.

options.title: Options
options.description: The options members rank in a ranked preference round.
options.x-notes: Set when a ranked-choice round opens and never changed afterwards (VotingRoundOpener via RankedBallotRules): two to twenty entries, each with a unique key, a label and optionally a Person uuid. Empty on every other voting method.

key.title: Key
key.description: A short name for the option that stays the same for the whole round.

label.title: Label
label.description: What members see for this option.

person.title: Person
person.description: The person this option stands for, when it is a candidate.

rankingResult.title: Ranking
rankingResult.description: The options in order of their Borda count points, with rank and points.
rankingResult.x-notes: Written by VotingRoundResults::tally() through BordaCount when a ranked round closes: key, label, points and rank per option. With N options a first place earns N minus 1 points.

winningOption.title: Winning option
winningOption.description: The key of the option that won the ranked vote.
winningOption.x-notes: Empty when the round is tied or had no ballots.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.description: The options in the order this member prefers them, first preference first.
ranking.x-notes: Only on a ranked-choice round, where value is `ranked`. The cast endpoint refuses a ranking that leaves an option out or names one twice.
